page_title: LOR 2-0 REI | Lorient v Reims 11/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+5' Yaya-Kader Fofana (Reims) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the top right corner, but Yvon Mvogo has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
90+2' Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
88' 39:61 – this is the current ball possession ratio.

87' 2 - 0 Goal! Bamba Dieng displays great vision and sends a pass to Tiemoue Bakayoko (Lorient), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball from close range in the back of the net. The score is 2:0.
85' Substitution. Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Theo Le Bris walks off.
82' Here comes a substitution. Mohamed Daramy is given a rest as he is replaced by Adama Bojang (Reims).
82' Will Still prepares a substitution. Sergio Akieme is replaced by Yaya-Kader Fofana (Reims).
79' Substitution. Formose Mendy (Lorient) on for Panos Katseris.
77' Lorient take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
75' Amir Richardson (Reims) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
73' Will Still decides to make a substitution. Joseph Okumu will be replaced by Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims).
72' A substitution has been made. Benjamin Stambouli is replaced by Amir Richardson (Reims).
72' Substitution. Laurent Abergel makes way for Tiemoue Bakayoko (Lorient).
71' We are about to witness a substitution. Bamba Dieng (Lorient) is replacing Mohamed Bamba.
71' That's the end of the game for Ayman Kari, who is replaced by Badredine Bouanani (Lorient).
71' Here is a change. Keito Nakamura is going off and Will Still gives the last tactical orders to Reda Khadra (Reims).
70' 1 - 0 Goal! Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) makes the score 1:0 after burying a close-range header in the bottom right corner after a good run and cross by Panos Katseris.
69' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle and it's Yunis Abdelhamid (Reims) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
66' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Thomas Foket (Reims).
64' Junya Ito (Reims) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
62' Marc Bollengier has a clear sight and sees a foul from Sergio Akieme (Reims).
60' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Montassar Talbi (Lorient) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
58' Close! Panos Katseris (Lorient) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
57' Theo Le Bris (Lorient) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
55' Reims have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
53' The ball rebounds off the defender into the path of Theo Le Bris (Lorient), who immediately strikes for goal from inside the box but sends it a whisker wide of the right post.
50' Panos Katseris (Lorient) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence.
49' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Reims comes to nothing.
48' Theo Le Bris (Lorient) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
47' The resulting set piece from Reims is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
46' The whistle blows and Marc Bollengier starts the second half.
45+1' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) was too forceful with his tackle and Marc Bollengier interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
43' The number of shots on goal at present is 1:2.
41' Yellow card. Benjamin Stambouli (Reims) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
39' A raking crossfield pass from Thomas Foket (Reims) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
37' Keito Nakamura (Reims) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.
35' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Marc Bollengier no option but to blow his whistle.
35' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Marc Bollengier saw the whole situation.
32' It must be a yellow card. It is. Laurent Abergel (Lorient) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
30' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle. Teddy Teuma (Reims) commits a foul after dangerous play.
27' The corner is swung in but Reims can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
24' The shot by Mohamed Daramy (Reims) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Yvon Mvogo.
24' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the right post.
22' Reims seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
19' Teddy Teuma (Reims) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
17' Marc Bollengier blows for a foul after Benjamin Stambouli (Reims) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
15' Junya Ito (Reims) gathers a nice lofted pass deep inside the box and attempts to put the ball low into the middle of the goal, but his shot is deflected away by one of the defending players.
13' It looks like Teddy Teuma (Reims) saw red with that tackle. Marc Bollengier won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
12' Reims can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
11' Reims failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
10' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Panos Katseris (Lorient).
7' Junya Ito (Reims) tries to catch the keeper off guard from long range, but the effort sails well wide of the right post.
5' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Reims.
3' What a chance that is! Panos Katseris (Lorient) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Reims will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Marc Bollengier.
